text:
lia: @channel quick sync — need to lock deploy windows & cutoffs for v2.17 across US / EU / APAC. Posting a proposed sweep; please ack or flag conflicts.

sam: can you post UTC times too? makes it easier to script cutoffs.

lia: sure — local + UTC below (proposal):
```
US (evening PT): 20:00-00:00 PT -> 03:00-07:00 UTC
EU (evening CET): 19:00-23:00 CET -> 18:00-22:00 UTC
APAC (evening SGT/AWST): 18:00-22:00 SGT -> 10:00-14:00 UTC

Region-specific branch merge cutoff: 24 hours before region window start (18:00 UTC day-before for US window above)
Changelog bump + smoke: 2 hours before region cutoff
Canary: 30m at 10% traffic, then 1h ramp to 50%
Rollback target: immediate fallback to v2.16 variant if error rate > 3%
```

maria: noted — changelog bump PRs must be merged and tagged before cutoff. i'll post a checklist.

cheng: dedicated pool note — we need ~2h GPU warm-up for cold nodes if scaling from 0. ops, can we reserve a couple of instances for the EU window?

ops-bot: @cheng requested reservation: reserved-pool-eu size=2 duration=04:00 UTC+1 -> scheduled. job=rb-2026-45

lia: thanks ops-bot. if pool reserved holds, we can drop warm-up to 15-30m. otherwise we should shift EU window +1h.

alex: canary plan question — who is owning monitoring + rollback? i can own metrics (latency/error dashboards) if ops owns the actual rollback switches.

sam: i'll own rollback switch + runbook. alex -> we'll pair on alerts and runbook run-through tomorrow.

maria: checklist (working):
- bump version in package.json + changelog PR (tag: v2.17.0)
- freeze branch -> create release branch at cutoff
- docs + migration note PRs merged
- release notes published after global windows finish

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for US window (03:15 UTC) -> canary-id=canary-179888-1. Auto-notify on error-rate > 2%.

sam: small ask — leave a 30m buffer between region cutoffs (so support can shift). otherwise ops will be juggling parallel rollbacks.

lia: good point. adjust times: push APAC start +30m, EU start -30m to create stagger. i'll update the table and push to the release calendar.

cheng: ack from infra — reserving eu pool, prepull images 90m before window. i'll post exact job id in #eng-infra.

maria: i'll do the changelog ownership and ping release notes. tagging @product for any last-minute copy. :thumbsup:

alex: pairing with sam tomorrow 10:00 PT to test rollback runbook.

lia: everyone ack if good, otherwise post conflicts here by EOD. owners: maria (changelog), sam (rollback), alex (metrics), cheng (infra), lia (coord). thanks! :white_check_mark:

sam: ack
cheng: ack
maria: ack
alex: ack
deploy-bot: canary scheduled
ops-bot: reservation confirmed
